title: Surrounded by Memory
content: This man was sitting by himself at the diner. I liked the cool colors of the walls and his jeans, in contrast to the warm-colored notes of his scrambled eggs and his face.The painting isgouacheandwatercolorin awatercolor sketchbookand it took about an hour.The words written around him with afountain penare a short poem byPercy Bysshe Shelley:Music, when soft voices die,Vibrates in the memory—Odours, when sweet violets sicken,Live within the sense they quicken.Rose leaves, when the rose is dead,Are heaped for the belovèd's bed;And so thy thoughts, when thou art gone,Love itself shall slumber on.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)
